scope: Initial India-oriented residential knowledge seed with Tamil Nadu emphasis.
limitations: Not an exhaustive catalogue of all Indian homes or all current building regulations.
No numerically enforceable setback, structural, fire or plumbing rule profiles have been certified.
Customer instructions and regional reference examples are not scientific or regulatory guarantees.
Proposed request patterns require implementation and evaluation before claims of automatic understanding.

customer_request_patterns.example: The road is north, but the main door must face east.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Does the first north-facing door mean the compound gate or a lobby door?

customer_request_patterns.example: Keep a shoe rack between the two entrance doors.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Should this be enclosed or a covered outdoor entrance?

customer_request_patterns.example: Put pooja in this corner, and I should pray facing this direction.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Please confirm whether the direction refers to the worshipper, deity or room door.

customer_request_patterns.example: Kitchen here, but I want to face east while cooking.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Is the location mandatory or a preference?
Are these finished internal dimensions, and may the hall rotate?

customer_request_patterns.example: Make a spacious house; decide the room sizes.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Which spaces matter most if the plot cannot fit every preference?

customer_request_patterns.example: Keep the water tank at ground level on this side.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Is this a storage tank or an underground sump?

customer_request_patterns.example: Run the downpipe along this side and leave walking space.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Is this supply, waste or rainwater piping?

customer_request_patterns.example: Keep the septic tank near this corner.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Is a public sewer available, and can the servicing route reach this location?

customer_request_patterns.example: Keep upstairs separate so tenants do not enter our house.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: How many rental units and which floors?

customer_request_patterns.example: Build ground now and leave provision for more floors.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: How many future floors should be considered in the structural brief?

customer_request_patterns.example: Parents should have a bedroom downstairs with an easy bathroom.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: What mobility or assistance needs should the route accommodate?

customer_request_patterns.example: Guests should not see the kitchen from the front door.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Do you prefer a closed kitchen or a screening partition?

customer_request_patterns.example: Use a Kerala roof with a Tamil courtyard and modern interiors.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Should the courtyard be open to the sky or covered?

customer_request_patterns.example: One Indian toilet and western toilets elsewhere.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: Which bathroom should use each style?

customer_request_patterns.example: Keep drying space, solar and tanks without blocking terrace access.
customer_request_patterns.clarifying_question: What equipment is planned now versus reserved for later?

vastu_modes.meaning: Enforce reviewed customer locks; explain conflicts; never silently relax.
Enforce selected mandatory items and optimise weighted preferences.
Apply no Vastu rules; keep other customer, site and building requirements.

open_discussion_items.proposed_default: Hide loose furniture/decor; preserve fixed kitchen and bath fittings.
Separate construction rate from itemised interiors/extras.
Editable client-reviewed presets plus project-specific customer locks.
Configurable per-edge setbacks; professionally consolidate current rules before automatic compliance claims.

no_api_key_behaviour.core: Forms, measured geometry, explicit constraints, 3D interaction and quotation should remain available.
no_api_key_behaviour.paragraph: Store notes and interpret only implemented local patterns; do not claim unrestricted language understanding.
no_api_key_behaviour.voice: Recording available; transcription needs a configured provider or installed local model.
no_api_key_behaviour.photorealism: Depends on assets, materials, lighting and a renderer; no API key is required for a local renderer, but hardware and render time still matter.
